official_reference.title: Hướng dẫn kỹ thuật tính toán và công bố chỉ số chất lượng không khí Việt Nam (VN_AQI)
official_reference.issuer: Tổng cục Môi trường, Bộ Tài nguyên và Môi trường
official_reference.scope: VN_AQI from quality-controlled data of continuous automatic ambient-air monitoring stations
official_reference.pm25_hourly_method: 12-hour Nowcast; at least 2 of the latest 3 hourly values must exist
official_reference.uncertainty: Current continued legal status was not independently established beyond the official agency-hosted document; applicability to this community sensor is not demonstrated.

additional_reference.title: QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT - Quy chuẩn kỹ thuật quốc gia về chất lượng không khí
additional_reference.issuer: Bộ Tài nguyên và Môi trường
additional_reference.scope: Ambient-air concentration limits; reviewed for context, not used as an AQI calculation method

vn_aqi_ineligibility_reasons: No evidence that the instrument and data meet statutory QA/QC requirements
Prototype uses one community PM2.5 sensor and cannot publish an official station-level VN_AQI
internal_coverage_note: The 9/12 coverage gate is a conservative prototype rule, not stated as a VN_AQI requirement in Decision 1459.
breakpoint_note: Concentration boundaries are the PM2.5 breakpoints in Decision 1459, reused only to label internal concentration bands. No AQI number or official VN_AQI category is produced.
